import sys

# Read the length of the array
n = int(input().strip())

# Initialize an array to store the elements
a = [0] * n

# Make n requests to find the sum of pairs of elements
for k in range(n):
    if k < n - 1:
        # Request the sum of two distinct elements
        print(f"? {k+1} {k+2 if k+2 <= n else 1}", flush=True)
        sys.stdout.flush()
        # Read the response
        response = int(input().strip())
        a[k] = response - a[k-1] if k > 0 else response
    else:
        # For the last element, use the first element to find the sum
        print(f"? {k+1} {1}", flush=True)
        sys.stdout.flush()
        response = int(input().strip())
        a[k] = response - a[0]

# Print the guessed array
print("!", " ".join(map(str, a)), flush=True)
sys.stdout.flush()
